item.title: Unsettled: The Search Between Wandering & Belonging
item.description:
Sat 19 Sep, 6:00 PM · Miami Marketta · See link
After multiple sold-out seasons across Australia and a 5-star review at Fringe World Perth , Unsettled: The Search Between Wandering & Belonging returns to the Gold Coast, for a special one-night performance. One woman. One suitcase. Too many existential crisis. What happens when home is no longer a place you can find on a map? Unsettled: The Search Between Wandering & Belonging is a fearless, funny, and deeply moving one-woman show about chasing dreams, getting lost along the way, and building a new life from scratch. With humour and intimate honesty, Agustina takes you on a wild ride through the heartbreak, comedy, and chaos of living abroad. Vulnerable, hilarious, and fiercely alive, Unsettled invites you to feel seen, laugh, cry, and maybe even find a piece of yourself along the way. What began as a street performance in Port Douglas has evolved into a multi-city, sold-out show , touring Magnetic Island, Airlie Beach, Noosa, Byron Bay, Gold Coast, Margaret River, and successful sell out seasons at Adelaide Fringe, Fringe World Perth, Sydney Fringe & Melbourne Fringe. Following a successful Byron Bay season, with nine performances and multiple sold-out nights, Unsettled heads just up the coast to Gold Coast. After previously appearing at Miami Marketta as part of HOLA Marketta the Winter Latin Festival , the show returns for a special standalone performance, bringing its playful storytelling to new audiences. This time, experience it in a cozy, intimate venue, perfect for getting up close and personal with the story. ⚠️Limited capacity. One night only. Don’t miss out 😏 ⏰ Doors open 6PM Show 7PM - 9PM 📌 Miami Marketta, Mona Lisa's Lair More than just a show! Enjoy live music before the performance , grab a drink and settle in for the evening. Following the show, there will be a Q&A and informal discussion with Agustina , exploring and unpacking some of the themes at the heart of Unsettled . Come for the story. Stay for the conversation

item.title: MANEVA & FABIO BRAZZA + TÚLIO - Brazilian Day
item.description:
Sun 13 Sep, 4:00 PM · Miami Marketta · See link
SUNDAY 13th of September | Miami Marketta | Gold Coast For the first time as part of the Brazilian Day Experience, one of Brazil's most beloved bands, Maneva, brings their acclaimed live show to the Gold Coast for a special night celebrating Brazilian music, culture, and community. With a career spanning over two decades, MANEVA has become one of the biggest names in Brazilian reggae, captivating millions of fans through their uplifting melodies, powerful lyrics, and unforgettable live performances. Known for hits such as Lágrimas de Alegria, Luz Que Me Traz Paz, and O Destino Não Quis, the band has built a devoted following throughout Brazil and around the world, delivering a unique blend of reggae, rock, and Brazilian rhythms that continues to inspire audiences of all ages. Sharing the stage is renowned Brazilian rapper, poet, and songwriter FÁBIO BRAZZA, one of the most respected voices in contemporary Brazilian hip-hop. Celebrated for his intelligent lyricism, storytelling, and powerful social commentary, Fábio Brazza's performances combine energy, authenticity, and artistry in a way that resonates deeply with audiences. Opening the celebration is Gold Coast-based Brazilian artist TÚLIO, whose music reflects the vibrant spirit of modern Brazil while representing the strength and passion of Australia's Brazilian community. More than just a concert, Brazilian Day Experience is a celebration of everything that makes Brazil unique. Enjoy authentic Brazilian food, cultural experiences, art, community connections, and an atmosphere filled with the colours, flavours, rhythms, and energy that have made Brazilian culture famous worldwide. Whether you're Brazilian, have Brazilian roots, or simply love great music and cultural experiences, this is your opportunity to be part of an unforgettable event bringing the heart of Brazil to the Gold Coast. One day. Three incredible artists. One unforgettable Brazilian celebration. Presented by Tropical Lab and Folia's Entertainment.
